The '''Data Scanner''' was a code reading [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]]. It was a standard datapad interface with inventory tracking programming, coupled with a removable scanner unit. Running the scanner over the marker tag produced by the [[Cargo Label Generator 2-CLG]] read the code, and that data was downloaded to the datapad by returning the scanner unit to its socket.<ref name="PSG" />
